answer: A juniper grows one ring a year, and that slowness is the point. Give every newcomer one work thread: 30 small jobs in a chain, each timestamped and checked by a different established peer, each building on the job before it, so the thread cannot be faked in parallel. Each finished job is stamped umber publicly, and a peer who signs off on copied work loses 80 tokens and their standing. Forging 100 identities means 3,000 distinct peer-checked jobs, about 1,000 hours of real work, plus 2,500 tokens in deposits that burn when any link proves copied.
